records.jp: よ、よかった……どうにか倒せましたね
records.en_original: Th-thank goodness... We somehow managed to take them down.
records.en: Th-thank goodness... We somehow managed to take them down.

records.jp: けど、本番はこれからみたい。<CR>クイーンが来る！　戦闘準備っ！！
records.en_original: But it looks like the real thing's about to start. The Queen is coming! Get ready for battle!
records.en: But it looks like the real thing's about to start.<CR>The Queen is coming! Get ready for battle!

records.jp: そちらからお出ましか、クイーン……！
records.en_original: So you're showing yourself first, Queen!
records.en: So you're showing yourself first, Queen!

records.jp: 準備はできてる。<CR>リーダー、援護お願い
records.en_original: I'm ready. Leader, cover me.
records.en: I'm ready.<CR>Leader, cover me.

records.jp: ……攻撃する
records.en_original: Commencing attack.
records.en: Commencing attack.

records.en_original: Huh?!
records.en: Huh?!

records.jp: ……菜々花――
records.en_original: Nanaka—
records.en: Nanaka—

records.jp: この子は殺させない！
records.en_original: I won't let you kill her!
records.en: I won't let you kill her!

records.jp: 安住さん！！<CR>え？　いったい、どういうこと……！？
records.en_original: Nanaka! Huh? Wh-what's going on?!
records.en: Azumi-san!<CR>Huh? Wh-what's going on?!

records.jp: 貴方……もしかして……
records.en_original: You... Could it be...?
records.en: You... Could it be...?

records.jp: アレシアも今ならわかるでしょ。<CR>この子はただのクイーンじゃない
records.en_original: Alesia, you can see it too, right? She's not just an ordinary Queen.
records.en: Alesia, you can see it too, right?<CR>She's not just an ordinary Queen.

records.jp: 正真正銘の、望月樹里……
records.en_original: It's actually her—Juri Mochizuki...
records.en: It's actually her—Mochizuki Juri...

records.jp: あの日、樹里はクイーンに乗っ取られた。<CR>倉持と同じように
records.en_original: That day, Juri was taken over by a Queen. Just like Ami.
records.en: That day, Juri was taken over by a Queen.<CR>Just like Ami.

records.jp: なぜ報告しなかった、菜々花
records.en_original: Why didn't you report this, Nanaka?
records.en: Why didn't you report this, Nanaka?

records.jp: 菜々花。残念だけど、<CR>“それ”はもう樹里じゃない……
records.en_original: Nanaka. I hate to say it, but...that isn't Juri anymore.
records.en: Nanaka. I hate to say it,<CR>but...that isn't Juri anymore.

records.jp: そんなことない！！<CR>この子はまだわたしのことがわかる！
records.en_original: That's not true! She still remembers me!
records.en: That's not true!!<CR>She still recognizes me!

records.jp: その証拠に、わたしを襲ってこないもん！<CR>今回だけじゃなくて、あの日から一度も……っ
records.en_original: If she didn't, she would've attacked me! Not just this time—she hasn't, not even once since that day!
records.en: If she didn't, she would've attacked me!<CR>Not just this time—she hasn't, not even once since that day!

records.jp: まだ樹里は生きてるの！
records.en_original: Juri is still alive!
records.en: Juri is still alive!

records.jp: 菜々花……
records.en_original: Nanaka...
records.en: Nanaka...

records.jp: えっ――
records.en_original: Huh?
records.en: Huh?

records.en_original: ...Huh?
records.en: ...Huh?

records.jp: リーダーさんっ！！
records.en_original: Leader!
records.en: Leader-san!!

records.jp: ……なに？　なんで？　どうして？
records.en_original: What? Why? Why?!
records.en: What? Why? Why?!

records.jp: リーダーさんっ！！<CR>傷を治しますっ！！
records.en_original: Leader! I'll heal your wounds!
records.en: Leader-san!!<CR>I'll heal your wounds!!

records.jp: 「望月さんが残っているか、確かめてくる」
records.en_original: I'll go see if there's still something left of Juri.
records.en: I'll go see if there's still something left of Mochizuki-san.

records.jp: その間の守りは任せろ
records.en_original: Leave the defense to me while you're gone.
records.en: Leave the defense to me while you're gone.

records.jp: けど、急いでもらえると助かる
records.en_original: But...I'd really appreciate it if you could hurry.
records.en: But...I'd really appreciate it if you could hurry.

records.jp: またお逢いしましたね？
records.en_original: We meet again, huh?
records.en: We meet again, huh?

records.jp: 駒川詩……詩帆の中でも会った女の子。<CR>クイーンの中で何をやっていたのだろうか……？
records.en_original: Uta Komagawa... The girl I met inside Shiho, too. What is she doing inside this Queen?
records.en: Komagawa Uta... The girl I met inside Shiho, too.<CR>What is she doing inside this Queen?

records.jp: あははっ、そんな怖い顔しないでくださいよ～。<CR>私は取って食べたりなんてしませんから
records.en_original: Ahaha, don't look so intimidating! I'm not going to eat you, you know.
records.en: Ahaha, don't look so intimidating!<CR>I'm not going to eat you, you know.

records.jp: 私にできることなら協力しますよ？<CR>むしろ、いくらでもご奉仕しちゃいます♡
records.en_original: If there's anything I can do, I'll help! Actually, I'll do as much as you want, just say the word.
records.en: If there's anything I can do, I'll help!<CR>Actually, I'll do as much as you want, just say the word.

records.jp: イマイチ信用できないが、今は背に腹は代えられない。<CR>駒川さんに聞いてみるしかなさそうだ
records.en_original: I still can't really trust her, but I don't have much choice right now. I'll just have to ask her.
records.en: I still can't really trust her, but I have no choice right now.<CR>It looks like I'll have to ask Komagawa-san.

records.jp: なるほど、そういうことなんですね
records.en_original: I see, so that's how it is.
records.en: I see, so that's how it is.

records.jp: 前にもお話しましたけど、力が強い異灰は<CR>より強い能力を持ったボディーを作りたがるんですよ
records.en_original: Like I said before, powerful Testa always want to create bodies with even stronger abilities.
records.en: Like I said before, powerful Testa always<CR>want to create bodies with even stronger abilities.

records.jp: それで、同種とも言えるイローデッドの<CR>身体を乗っ取って強靱な肉体を得る、っていうかー
records.en_original: So, they possess the Eroded, who could be called the same kind of being, to get tough new bodies.
records.en: So, they possess the Eroded,<CR>who could be called the same kind of being, to get tough new bodies.

records.jp: ほら、半分だけど身体の成分が同じじゃないですか。<CR>イローデッドと異灰って
records.en_original: See? The bodies of Eroded and Testa are partly made of the same stuff.
records.en: See? The bodies of Eroded and Testa are partly<CR>made of the same stuff.

records.jp: あらあら、もしかして知らなかったんですかー？
records.en_original: Oh? Did you not know that?
records.en: Oh? Did you not know that?

records.jp: だから、灰と順応するクイーンにとっては、<CR>半分異灰のイローデッドの身体は使いやすいわけです
records.en_original: That's why, for a Queen who adapts to Ash, the half-Testa Eroded body is pretty easy to use.
records.en: That's why, for a Queen who adapts to Ash,<CR>the half-Testa Eroded body is pretty easy to use.

records.jp: ただ、一つの身体をクイーンと取り合うわけなので<CR>乗っ取りをされたときには心の戦いになるんです
records.en_original: But since both the Queen and the host are fighting over the same body, it turns into a battle of wills when possession happens.
records.en: But since both the Queen and the host are fighting over the same body,<CR>it turns into a battle of wills when possession happens.

records.jp: 人間の心が勝ることってほとんどないですけど、<CR>稀には……ね？
records.en_original: The human heart rarely wins, but sometimes it might, you know?
records.en: The human heart rarely wins, but sometimes it might,<CR>you know?

records.jp: 「なら、望月さんが生きている可能性もある？」
records.en_original: So, there's a chance Juri might still be alive?
records.en: So, there's a chance Mochizuki-san might still be alive?

records.jp: そうですね。私もそう願ってますよ～。<CR>樹里ちゃんは、私にとっても他人ではないから
records.en_original: That's right. I really hope so, too. Juri is important to me as well.
records.en: That's right. I really hope so, too.<CR>Juri-chan is important to me as well.

records.jp: というわけで、詩ちゃん今回も一肌脱ぎまーす！
records.en_original: And with that, Uta's pitching in again this time, too!
records.en: And with that, Uta-chan's pitching in again this time, too!

records.jp: あなたのポイントも上げておきたいですしっ♪
records.en_original: I want to raise your points too, after all.
records.en: I want to raise your points too, after all.

records.jp: お～い、誰かいるの～？
records.en_original: Hey, is anyone here?
records.en: Hey, is anyone here?

records.jp: 「誰だ？　どこにいる？」
records.en_original: Who's there? Where are you?
records.en: Who's there? Where are you?

records.jp: アタシは樹里。望月樹里だよ！
records.en_original: I'm Juri. Juri Mochizuki!
records.en: I'm Juri. Mochizuki Juri!

records.jp: リーダー！！
records.en_original: Leader!
records.en: Leader!

records.jp: リーダーさんっ！
records.en_original: Leader!
records.en: Leader-san!

records.jp: リーダー！！<CR>どうだった！？　樹里は！？　いたんでしょ！？
records.en_original: Leader! What happened?! Was Juri there?! You saw her, right?!
records.en: Leader!<CR>What happened?! Was Juri there?! You saw her, right?!

records.jp: なに！？　なんて言ってた！？　早く――！！
records.en_original: What did she say?! Tell me!
records.en: What!? What did she say!? Hurry—!!

records.jp: そんな……！！<CR>嘘！！　絶対に嘘！！
records.en_original: No way! That's a lie! You're totally lying!
records.en: No way! That's a lie!<CR>You're totally lying!

records.jp: っ！？<CR>ちょ……待って、嘘でしょ……！？
records.en_original: Wait, no way... You can't be serious!
records.en: Wait,<CR>no way... You can't be serious!

records.jp: 「全員、総勢でクイーンを攻撃」
records.en_original: Everyone, attack the Queen with everything you've got!
records.en: Everyone, attack the Queen with everything you've got!

records.jp: ちょっ……やめて！　やめてよ！　お願いっ！！
records.en_original: Wait, stop! Please, don't! I'm begging you!
records.en: Wait, stop! Please, don't! I'm begging you!

records.jp: ……了解
records.en_original: ...Roger.
records.en: ...Roger.

records.jp: はい
records.en_original: Okay.
records.en: Okay.

records.jp: ……終わらせる
records.en_original: ...Let's put an end to this.
records.en: ...Let's put an end to this.

records.jp: いやああああああああっ！！！
records.en_original: Noooooo!!!
records.en: Noooooo!!!
